name: Vesta
tagline: The asteroid belt's brightest world — a protoplanet that survived the dawn of the Solar System.
history: Vesta is a leftover protoplanet — a body that was differentiating into crust, mantle and iron core when planet formation stalled. Its basaltic surface tells of ancient lava flows, and the giant Rheasilvia impact basin at the south pole blasted fragments into space that still fall to Earth as HED meteorites. NASA's Dawn spacecraft orbited Vesta in 2011–2012 before moving on to Ceres — the first mission to orbit two worlds.
